top_choice_rationale: P002 recognizes a defined chemical design, reversible-terminator nucleotides with cleavable fluorophores incorporated by an engineered polymerase on surface-bound clusters, whose claims have been tested by thousands of laboratories for two decades. The two-name allocation and the citation worded on the terminator chemistry, not on genomics, answer the technology objection. P001 is the strongest rival but leaves the ternary-complex structural work (Ciulli) outside the trio and joins two historically distinct lineages. P003 attaches a less mature, contested Liu-only base-editing part to the strongest candidate.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; Stockholm University colleague of Secretary Peter Brzezinski, who is not a candidate, and my field (electron crystallography of porous materials) is adjacent only to B043, which is not in the slate
